name: Canonical Data Gap Audit
problem: A team has a dataset or decision problem and needs to know what is missing, conflicted, stale, inaccessible or governance-restricted before trusting analysis built on top of it.
intent_terms: what data is missing for this decision
find provenance problems in this data
design a plan to close these data gaps
inputs: Authorized dataset/domain plus decision question; optional geography, population scope, metric/subject and source refs.
outputs: Explicit gaps and types, severity, evidence/confidence, affected decisions, source conflicts, collection options/effort, governance constraints and next actions.
pricing: No approved fixed machine price/payment path verified. Raven data-product concepts are hypotheses unless separately approved.
confirmation: Read-only audit within authorized dataset scope. Any collection project, partner request, records linkage or publication is a separate gated action.
payment_authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path for this specific audit.
invocation_status: LIVE: public machine discovery docs plus central Evercraft MCP matching. Commercial execution remains verification-gated; no automatic checkout or payment obligation.
